crossRefs.note: Those who fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, including what happened to those who were…
When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

parallels.note: Those who fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, including what happened to those who were…
When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

translations.web: Those who fed them fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.
translations.bsb: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
translations.kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
translations.asv: And they that fed them fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they came to see what it was that had come to pass.
